notes: Read SKILL.md in full. A gated specify-plan-tasks-implement workflow: optional capability map for multi-capability requests, a six-area spec template, reframing vague requirements as success criteria, and a hard stop for human approval after writing the spec.

The agent writes SPEC*.md, tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md in the user's repo; example build/test commands are placeholders the spec records. No installs, credentials, network or destructive commands; it explicitly ends the turn for human approval before planning or coding.

Plan, task and implementation phases defer to sibling skills (planning-and-task-breakdown, incremental-implementation, test-driven-development, context-engineering, api-and-interface-design; SKILL.md:174, 186, 202, 214) and slash commands like /build. The skill's core spec-writing behavior is self-contained and it supplies inline plan/task templates, so these are treated as optional pointers; a user without those skills gets a less detailed later phase.
